title: No audio after suspend
body: After waking, I don't have any audio playback. De audio only comes back after reboot. It does hang during shutdown however. I'm using Plasma and pipewire and tried using both the 6.14 kernel and lts 6.12. When I physically unplug-plugin the USB audio card, the problem disappears. During my own search I have noticed a couple of posts from 2022 about similar issues. It was a kernelbug then, could this be the case now as well? If more info is needed, ask away. Could somebody help me?
